scenes.heading: AI BUILDS *IN BLENDER*
scenes.say: Your AI can now build scenes inside Blender, not just chat about them.

scenes.heading: MEET *MCP FOR BLENDER PRO*
scenes.say: It is MCP for Blender Pro, an open-source add-on that plugs AI into Blender itself.

scenes.heading: HOW IT *WORKS*
scenes.say: You describe the scene you want. It inspects what is already there, then builds and edits step by step.

scenes.heading: FOUND *FAST*
scenes.label: GitHub · first two days
scenes.say: Blender artists gave it hundreds of stars in its first two days.

scenes.heading: *TWO-MINUTE* SETUP
scenes.say: You install it as a Blender extension, add your model key, and start directing the scene.

scenes.heading: BEFORE YOU *INSTALL*
scenes.say: The catches are real: the release targets Windows first, you need a recent Blender, and cloud models cost money. In return, the code is MIT-licensed and open, and local models work through Ollama.
Want your AI to build scenes, not just pictures? Comment Blender and follow for tools like this.

youtube.title: AI Inside Blender: It Builds Scenes From Chat | MCP for Blender Pro
youtube.description:
MCP for Blender Pro is a free MIT add-on that gives AI 21 scene tools inside Blender 4.2+: describe a scene, it inspects what exists, then creates and edits objects step by step — with a visual chat, agent team and built-in MCP server. Works with OpenAI, Claude, Gemini or local Ollama. 551 GitHub stars in two days. Catches: the release targets Windows first and cloud models cost money.
Source: https://github.com/anujasid/blender-ai-mcp-addon
